en.title: Consent forms
en.summary: The wording of the consent forms patients sign, in English and Amharic, printed from a patient's Consents tab.

sections.heading: The wording is yours
sections.body: Six forms come ready — treatment, surgery or extraction, anaesthetic or sedation, radiographs, photographs and sharing records — in plain English and Amharic. Change them to the wording your clinic and its lawyer approve, or add more: a form for wisdom teeth beside the general surgical one.

sections.heading: Placeholders
sections.body: Write {patient}, {clinic}, {treatment} and {clinician} where the form should name them. They are filled in when printing; a treatment or clinician not chosen prints as a line to write on. Write them in Latin letters in the Amharic wording too. A blank line starts a new paragraph.

sections.heading: Retiring a form
sections.body: Set it Inactive to stop it being offered. A form already signed keeps its words: they are on the paper.

am.title: የስምምነት ቅጾች
am.summary: ታካሚዎች የሚፈርሙባቸው የስምምነት ቅጾች ቃላት፣ በእንግሊዝኛና በአማርኛ፣ ከታካሚው Consents ትር የሚታተሙ።

sections.heading: ቃላቱ የእርስዎ ናቸው
sections.body: ስድስት ቅጾች ተዘጋጅተው ይመጣሉ — ሕክምና፣ ቀዶ ሕክምና ወይም ጥርስ ማውጣት፣ ማደንዘዣ፣ ራጅ፣ ፎቶግራፍ እና መረጃ ማጋራት። ክሊኒክዎና የሕግ አማካሪዎ ወደሚያጸድቁት ቃላት ይቀይሩዋቸው ወይም ሌሎችን ይጨምሩ።

sections.heading: ቦታ ያዦች
sections.body: {patient}፣ {clinic}፣ {treatment} እና {clinician} ቅጹ እንዲጠራቸው በሚፈልጉበት ቦታ ይጻፉ። ሲታተም ይሞላሉ፤ ያልተመረጠ ሕክምና ወይም ሐኪም እንደ መጻፊያ መስመር ይታተማል። በአማርኛው ቃላት ውስጥም በላቲን ፊደላት ይጻፉዋቸው። ባዶ መስመር አዲስ አንቀጽ ይጀምራል።

sections.heading: ቅጽን ማቆም
sections.body: እንዳይቀርብ Inactive ያድርጉት። አስቀድሞ የተፈረመ ቅጽ ቃላቱን ይይዛል፦ በወረቀቱ ላይ ናቸው።
